newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial wins two casino contracts.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial wins two casino contracts.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Tuesday it received contracts to provide its GameCash services at Win River Casino in Redding, Calif. and at Chumash Casino in Santa Ynez, Calif.

It also said it discontinued its credit card cash advance operation at the Palace Casino, Biloxi, Miss., as a result of a change in ownership due to the casino's previous bankruptcy filing. Discontinuing service there is not expected to materially hurt Game Financial's future earnings, it said.
The company's GameCash services will become operational at the two California casinos during the first quarter of 1997.

Game Financial currently operates in 77 locations. It provides gaming establishments with services that allow their patrons to draw cash through use of credit card cash advance services, check cashing services and automated teller machines.
